Evidence says: RNA was extracted from amygdala samples of eight female Brd1+/- mice and eight WT littermates. For each genotype, two eight-animal pools were prepared from equal RNA amounts from the same eight contributors. RNA was pooled before cDNA synthesis and library preparation. Additional file 10 labels contributors etc. So combining occurred at RNA stage before cDNA synthesis and library prep. Options: rna_before_library = RNA from different animals is physically combined before cDNA synthesis and library preparation. That matches. indexed_libraries_only no. numerical_average_only no. tissue_before_extraction no. other no. not_stated no. conflicting? no incompatible. So q1 = rna_before_library.

Q2: What biological attribution is established for a gene-expression profile from one selected pooled library in reported analysis? Options: pool_aggregate = profile describes combined contributors to that pool; not separately observed for each. all_individuals_resolved = separate complete profile every contributing animal. some_individuals_resolved = some separate. new_single_animal no. not_stated? Evidence: bulk analysis counts reads into gene-expression profiles for prepared libraries. The study separately sequenced individual samples and three-animal pools for comparison. Those separate individual profiles are available but are not observations produced by four selected eight-animal pooled libraries. So for selected pooled library, profile is aggregate of combined contributors, not individually resolved. So q2 = pool_aggregate. Need maybe consider if evidence says "The reported bulk analysis counts reads into gene-expression profiles for the prepared libraries." That's pool_aggregate. There is no deconvolution. So pool_aggregate.
